llm.summary: This skill is coherent, but it enables real-money leveraged crypto trading with broad API authority and unclear user-level limits.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to let an agent enroll and open or close gTrade perpetual trades through CAI custodial E-mode, including leverage and intent_usd parameters; that is high-impact financial authority.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow requires hosted enrollment confirmation, but after enrollment it allows agent-initiated open and close trades and says v1 has no per-user limit UI; server caps are named but not quantified.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a markdown-only skill with no executable files or package dependencies, but setup requires storing a CAI_API_KEY secret with platform or full API scope.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Credential use and networked trading are aligned with the stated purpose, but full/platform API scope and leveraged perpetual trading are broader and riskier than a narrowly scoped, per-trade confirmation flow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The hosted enrollment appears to grant ongoing automation authority after one user confirmation; the artifact does not describe revocation, per-user limits, exact caps, or first-trade risk confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Only install this if you understand that an enrolled agent may place leveraged crypto trades that can lose money. Use the narrowest CAI API scope available, verify the actual server-side dollar caps before enabling it, start with very small trade sizes and low leverage, and confirm how to revoke enrollment or rotate the API key.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The finding matches artifact evidence: the skill discloses real-money gTrade perps, leverage, server caps, and no per-user limit UI. This is purpose-aligned, not malicious, but it materially supports Review because the financial authority is high impact and under-scoped.
